nativeValidation.setup: Run in one Bash shell at the stated commit in a checkout short enough for the runtime's Unix socket. The focused fixture builds the real guest helper and starts local disposable processes.
expectedResults: The focused test runs and passes on Darwin arm64.
Pause observes the stopped helper through the native ps probe. Worker enumeration then returns an error that wraps context.Canceled.
After rollback, the helper, shell and sleeper run. A fresh Pause stops all three and Resume continues all three.
unperformedOrUnavailable: Native execution is pending on m3-16.
The Linux cross-build uses CGO_ENABLED=0. This fixture requires no cgo, Virtualization.framework, signing, administrator password, CMake, IPSW, or macOS guest image.
